title: Implement uniaxial_tension_hardening()
objective: Implement uniaxial_tension_hardening(E, nu, sigma_y0, K, n, eps_total) -> (stress, eps_p) in verify/analytical.py. Computes the analytical uniaxial stress-strain curve for power-law J2 hardening. Critical reference for Phase 4 J2 E2E test.
implementation_steps: Implement uniaxial_tension_hardening(E, nu, sigma_y0, K, n, eps_total) -> tuple[float, float]
Elastic regime: if E*eps_total < sigma_y0, return (E*eps_total, 0.0)
Plastic regime: solve sigma = sigma_y0 + K * eps_p^n with eps_total = sigma/E + eps_p
Use scipy.optimize.brentq or Newton iteration for implicit solve
acceptance_criteria: Above yield: σ follows σ = σ_y0 + K*ε_p^n
Total strain decomposition: ε_total = σ/E + ε_p
risks: Risk: implicit solve may not converge for extreme hardening exponents. Mitigation: use robust root-finding (Brent's method) with bracketing.
